questions.question: When Jesus saw a large crowd that was like sheep without a shepherd, what did He begin to do for them?

answers.text: Pray with them by the sea
Sing psalms with them on the shore

questions.question: Before Jesus fed the crowd with five loaves and two fish, what did He have the people do?

answers.text: Sit down in groups on the green grass
Head off to the villages in groups
